title: Fix Broken Test Collection (Category C)
body: Test coverage is critically low (2/10) because `pytest` fails to collect tests due to `ModuleNotFoundError` and `ImportError`. This prevents any verification of the codebase. Immediate action is required to fix import paths and ensure tests can run.

title: Eliminate False Green CI (Category H)
body: The CI/CD pipeline (Category H, Grade 4/10) uses `|| echo` to mask failures in linting, type checking, and testing. This creates a false sense of security. The pipeline must be updated to fail fast on errors.

title: Standardize Error Handling (Category D)
body: Error handling (Category D, Grade 4/10) is inconsistent, with legacy code likely using broad exception handlers. Standardize on custom exceptions and remove broad `except Exception:` blocks.

title: Modernize Data Handling (Category K)
body: Data handling (Category K, Grade 4/10) relies on monolithic scripts and likely inefficient in-memory processing. Refactor `Data_Processor_r0.py` to use stream processing and schema validation.

title: Implement Universal Logging (Category L)
body: Logging (Category L, Grade 4/10) is inconsistent and relies on `print` statements. Replace all `print` calls with `logging` module calls and consider structured logging.

title: Improve Scalability (Category N)
body: Scalability (Category N, Grade 4/10) is limited by monolithic architecture. Break down the data processor into modular components to allow independent scaling.
